  date, the title, the excerpt and a read link.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Post, PostLabels } from "../blocks/post-card.types";

  export type PostOverlayCardProps = {
    p: Post;
    labels: PostLabels;
    ratio?: "4/3" | "16/9";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";

  let { p, labels, ratio = "4/3" }: PostOverlayCardProps = $props();
</script>

<Box class="relative overflow-hidden rounded" data-testid="post-overlay">
  <MediaFrame alt={p.title} ratio={ratio} class={(((ratio as string) === "4/3") ? "min-h-80" : "min-h-64")} />
  <Stack gap="2" align="start" class="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4 rounded bg-background p-4">
    <Group gap="2" align="center">
      <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm">
        {p.category}
      </Badge>
      <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {p.date}
      </Text>
    </Group>
    <Title as={3} size="base" weight="semibold">
      {p.title}
    </Title>
    <Text size="sm" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", "line-clamp-2")}>
      {p.excerpt}
    </Text>
    <Link href="#/" size="sm" data-testid="read">
      {labels.read}
      <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" size={16} />
    </Link>
  </Stack>
</Box>
